summary: BMO Financial Group filed a Form 6-K with its Q2 2026 earnings release. The filing reports net income of $2,630M (EPS $3.53), adjusted net income $2,733M (adj. EPS $3.67), and a 5% dividend increase to $1.71/share. Results show a 34% YoY net income rise and 13.0% CET1 ratio. This is routine periodic earnings disclosure, not a special situation event. No M&A, activism, restructuring, or other corporate action is announced. The 6-K is a foreign private issuer equivalent of a U.S. earnings press release. There is nothing to watch from a risk-arb perspective.
